feature_contract.goal: Preserve the complete visible car-selector and frontend menu texture upload for original opaque 24-bit BGR DDS images, including correct color and opacity across all mip levels and padded source rows, without affecting other alpha textures or the original fallback renderer.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only shared game D3D9 fast UI DDS loader in src/hooks_textures.cpp and its targeted regression. No R84 world/eye stereo reprojection, GOAL, +TIME, lens, normal UI layout, original game input, FFB, SkyGlow, R26_SAFE rollback, DX11 or frozen DXVK source modification.
trace_stages: Original UI DDS 24-bit RGB bitmasks map packed BGR pixels and possibly padded DDSD_PITCH rows to D3DFMT_R8G8B8 in GetD3DFormatFromPixelFormat.
Fast D3DXCreateTextureFromFileInMemoryEx_Custom previously requested a D3D9 R8G8B8 surface and assumed source/destination row byte count identity even though supported opaque GPU storage is X8R8G8B8.

Transform every original BGR24 texel and mip row to native X8R8G8B8 with explicit 0xFF opaque high byte before game sprite Draw; preserve original D3DX retry when CreateTexture or preflight fails and let existing R84 per-eye UI composition operate unchanged.
subcomponents: Convert genuine 24-bit DDS data into supported opaque X8R8G8B8 surface with correct BGR ordering and explicit nontransparent high byte, including each mip level.

Separate padded three-byte source row pitch from expanded four-byte GPU row size; validate the destination LockRect pitch while retaining source payload preflight and original-D3DX fallback, and extend targeted negative regression guards.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Original vehicle-select/menu RGB24 DDS through D3D9 GPU texture creation and sprite draw
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: 24-bit source BGR triples convert into X8R8G8B8 pixels with preserved B/G/R and fully opaque X byte on every packed or padded mip row, avoiding an unsupported 24-bit D3D texture upload.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Existing D3D9 A8/X8 textures, original DDS replacement retry and R84 optical/input boundaries
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: RGBA and existing 32-bit opaque swizzle remain byte-for-byte unchanged; malformed, truncated, unsupported or pitch-invalid DDS still defer to original D3DX and no global sampler, stereo, FFB, input or SkyGlow changes occur.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Exact SHA Win32 R84 game loader, fallback x86, x64 OpenXR host, Active package, HUD and source domain workflows
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: The validation-bearing final SHA passes mandatory DX9Ex Active policy/game/host/full-chain/package, Domain Isolation, HUD Inspector and Full Source Impact; real Quest3 screenshot acceptance remains untested.

diagnosis.root_cause: GetD3DFormatFromPixelFormat recognizes 24-bit R8G8B8 DDS, but the fast loader forwarded this format directly to D3D9 CreateTexture and used packed source 3-byte row size to validate destination LockRect stride rather than converting to a widely supported 32-bit opaque texture.
source_trace: DDS input accepts R8G8B8 masks and computes three bytes per source pixel.
Fast loader previously preserved format_orig as format_present except A8B8G8R8/X8B8G8R8 swizzle, so R8G8B8 allocated three-byte GPU target or failed.
New fast path allocates X8R8G8B8 and converts each pitched source row to four-byte opaque GPU rows for all mip levels.
alternatives_rejected: Globally treating 24-bit RGB as A8 alpha-bearing changes opaque sprites and can create incorrect transparency.
Changing the R84 stereo owner or menu aspect would not fix an unsupported source DDS pixel format at texture upload.
Global packed memory copy violates DDSD_PITCH and D3D LockRect row-stride contracts.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Source code expands BGR24 to native X8R8G8B8 with constexpr asserted channel and alpha identity, checks GPU destination pitch and preserves source pitch, existing A8/X8 swizzle and original D3DX retry.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Existing HUD DDS loader self-test includes deliberate mutated source/pitch/fallback checks; extended guard checks for RG24 to X8 destination, output row size and conversion write; exact CI pending.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Only game-owned texture data changes before Draw; R84 screen HUD stereo eye routing, host compositor, head pose and presentation are untouched.

ci_evidence.initial_hud_failure: DDS regression probe pinned destination pitch to source rowBytes despite expanded 24-bit output
ci_evidence.repair: Added exact task feature contract and updated target verifier to insist on actual destinationRowBytes plus RGB24 conversion checks; required workflows unchanged.

runtime_evidence: Quest3/VDXR and original car-selection screen not run in this environment; no claim that white selection textures or HUD artifacts are fixed.
hold_reason: Awaiting exact-SHA mandatory CI; Quest3/VDXR optical verification separately pending.
